# CyberGuard AI — Autonomous Multi-Agent Cybersecurity Platform

> CyberGuard AI unites real-time endpoint telemetry sensors, multi-agent AI threat correlation, verified cybersecurity analyst investigations, and organizational containment war-rooms into a unified defense engine.

## Overview
- Platform Name: CyberGuard AI
- Description: Enterprise-grade autonomous cybersecurity platform for individual users, security analysts, and enterprise organizations.
- Primary Technologies: Python FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PostgreSQL, React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query.
- License: Proprietary & Commercial Security Platform.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-Agent Defense Engine: Autonomous detection for unauthorized logins, persistence mechanisms, ransomware, brute-force anomalies, and malicious processes.
- Personal Workspace: Telemetry for personal devices (Windows, Linux, macOS), Gmail/email forensics, real-time log ingestion, network inspection, and direct communication with verified analysts.
- Analyst Workspace: Investigation workbench, case management, digital evidence library with cryptographic SHA-256 validation, forensic AI reports, and service marketplace.
- Organization Workspace: Collaborative incident rooms, employee posture tracking, automated breach containment, and targeted security operations.

## Security & Privacy Guidelines
- Zero Mock Data: All metrics, telemetry, cases, and logs represent genuine persistent database records.
- End-to-End Scoped Channels: Direct messaging and case communications are strictly isolated per peer session.
- Cryptographic Verification: All forensic evidence items are indexed with immutable SHA-256 hashes.
